car-battery-jump.shows: A white humanoid robot (SoftBank Pepper) indoors beside a tablet.
car-battery-jump.why: No car, no battery, no road. Nothing connects it to the service.

appliance-repair.shows: Overhead view of a person annotating engineering drawings at a desk, with a Stanley toolbox and cutting mat.
appliance-repair.why: Drafting, not appliance diagnosis. No appliance appears.

furniture-assembly.shows: A person in a respirator mask and safety goggles wiping a window frame with a yellow cloth.
furniture-assembly.why: Cleaning, not assembly — and the PPE reads as pandemic-era sanitising.

moving-help.shows: Exterior of a modern timber-clad house at dusk, lit from inside.
moving-help.why: No move, no boxes, no people. Architectural stock.

elder-assistance.shows: A woman in a white clinical coat smiling outdoors in front of trees.
elder-assistance.why: A clinical coat implies the medical and nursing care this page explicitly says it does NOT provide. The image contradicts the scope statement directly beneath it.

package-delivery.shows: A large fulfilment warehouse: racking, yellow totes and stacked parcels.
package-delivery.why: Implies a postal network, which the page explicitly denies ('a local courier run, not postal shipping — there is no network behind it').

tv-mounting.shows: A large television standing on a media unit, screen full of streaming app tiles (Netflix, Spotify, BBC iPlayer, ITV Hub, Channel 4, My5), with bias lighting behind.
tv-mounting.why: The TV is NOT wall-mounted, which is the entire service. Also third-party brand marks, and UK-only broadcasters shown to a US/Canada audience.

wait-in-line.shows: Close-up of two people shaking hands in an office.
wait-in-line.why: No queue. Reads as a business deal.

listening-service.shows: Five people around a wooden table in a cabin, all working on laptops.
listening-service.why: A co-working scene for a service that is a one-to-one audio call with nobody present.

tech-setup.shows: People seated along a wooden table writing in notebooks; no devices being set up.

package-return.shows: Empty red and black paper gift bags arranged on a black surface, shot from above.
package-return.why: Retail gift bags, not parcels being returned to a carrier.

errand-runner.shows: A couple cooking together at a hob in a bright kitchen.
errand-runner.why: Cooking at home, not running errands.

date-companion.shows: A person in a dress holding an open cookbook with a photograph of a vegetable dish.
date-companion.why: A cookbook, not an occasion or a dinner companion.

sleep-call-companion.shows: A woman lying in a lavender field with her eyes closed, shot from above in daylight.
sleep-call-companion.why: Daylight outdoors for a night-time phone call; also reads as wellness marketing for a service that is not a treatment.

maid-service.shows: A vacuum head on grey carpet covered in metallic party confetti, bare feet behind.
maid-service.why: Cleaning is right, but confetti frames it as one-off party clean-up rather than regular household cleaning.

shopping-companion.shows: A woman in sunglasses and a burgundy coat holding many shopping bags, styled as a fashion shot.
shopping-companion.why: Reads as personal styling, which this page lists as NOT included.

designated-driver.shows: A red Audi TT sports car being driven on a tree-lined road.
designated-driver.why: Car-related, but a sports car in motion with no visible driver or passenger does not show the service.

motorcycle-taxi.shows: A red Ducati sports motorcycle parked in a concrete car park.
motorcycle-taxi.why: Correct vehicle type, but no rider, passenger or helmet — a parked sports bike, not a passenger ride.

wedding-guest.shows: A bride and groom close together in backlit sunlight, the bride holding a bouquet.
wedding-guest.why: Shows the couple, not the guests this service supplies.

dog-walking.shows: A brown and white border collie outdoors on a beach, ears up, mouth open.
dog-walking.why: Clearly a dog. No lead or walker visible, but it does not mislead.

grocery-pickup.shows: Groceries laid out on a white cloth: bananas, courgettes, pomegranate, tinned corn, maple syrup, spinach, milk.

house-check-in.shows: A timber and stone house at dusk with interior lights on and a planted garden.
house-check-in.why: An unattended house in the evening suits a check-in visit.

property-inspection.shows: A white two-storey house with a veranda, palm trees and a swimming pool, under a clear sky.
property-inspection.why: A property exterior is reasonable for a condition visit.

event-companion.shows: A long banquet table set with glassware, plates and a bright floral centrepiece.
event-companion.why: A formal event setting matches the service.

rent-a-friend.shows: Eight people seen from behind, arms across each other's shoulders, looking out at a bay with cable cars.
rent-a-friend.why: Platonic company, which is the service.

family-standin.shows: A large group silhouetted holding hands on a beach at sunset.
family-standin.why: A family group without implying anything official.
